name: Rapunzel's Fry Pan Sweet Bread & Attila's Cupcake
whyItWorks: Soft fry-pan brioche pastry with vanilla ice cream and Attila's tender red velvet cupcake use refined cake flour with 0g insoluble husks or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose the Fry Pan Sweet Bread (with vanilla ice cream and chocolate sauce) or Attila's Sublime Cupcake; skip the Rote Grütze Berry Sundae (berry seeds) and Lemon Messcake (citrus).
